text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, March 4, 2024, Appeal DDRT2024-05.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Granted the request from the Applicant's representative for an adjournment under file Appeal DDRT2024-05, Orlando Jimenez Nunez until its meeting on October 10, 2024, and directed that the matter be deemed peremptory on the Applicant.
